fields.description: Binghatti Aquarise is a water-inspired apartment development in Business Bay. Curved balconies surround studios and larger homes, with separate Island layouts and selected private-pool designs. The building combines residential accommodation with ground-floor retail.

reviewCoverage.residences: Studio through four-bedroom mix and separate Island plans verified; private pools not attributed to every home.

overview: The brochure distinguishes 1,598 residential homes from 28 retail units. Its residential mix includes 688 studios, 736 one-bedroom, 152 two-bedroom, 10 three-bedroom and 12 four-bedroom homes. These are planned counts, not availability.
research.locationNote: Business Bay, Dubai Water Canal setting. Check the selected home’s actual outlook and access; marketing views are not an entitlement.
research.priceNote: The developer hero advertises from AED 999,999. Property Finder instead labels AED 2m as its launch guide. Different guides do not establish current available-unit stock; obtain a selected-unit quotation.
research.paymentNote: The developer FAQ gives 20% booking, 50% during construction and 30% on completion. Property Finder displays 20/20/60 but labels that offer valid until 31 August 2026. That expired promotion is not adopted. Obtain a signed, unit-specific dated schedule.
research.handoverNote: The developer FAQ forecasts Q1 2027; Property Finder forecasts October 2027, including 30 October in its timeline. Neither source resolves the discrepancy or confirms actual completion.

unresolved: Confirm current availability, furnishing specification, price, service charges, parking entitlement and contractual completion. The developer says apartments are generally furnished; this is not a unit-specific inclusion schedule.
The brochure’s published total unit areas include balconies, not just enclosed accommodation. Marketing suite measurements are not independently surveyed net interiors.

Project-level floor descriptions differ in simplification between brochure and FAQ. Use approved plans rather than deriving a total building height from shorthand. Selected pool designs do not establish a private pool in every apartment. Images remain illustrative.
